added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: list_plan_reviews enumerates the project directories it reads committed reviews from via review_store_root().iterdir(), so with project=None a project whose reviews are all committed and whose staging project directory does not exist is invisible to declined_recurrence (reckon/crew/plan_review.py:1063), which calls it without a project; the committed tree is the durable copy the change exists to read, so the fleet-wide enumeration should reach it without depending on a staging directory existing.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against the base a5e0eeb3; one commit 389a80a4 adds _select_stored_record, _build_store_indexes/_store_indexes/_review_run_index/record_for_review_run in review.py, the committed branches in plan_review.py, and repoints promotion._staging_review_record_by_run at the store index, plus 251 lines of tests and the fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/test_reviews_read_the_committed_store_first.py with five sibling modules under --basetemp, EXIT=0 on the manifest tests line and a non-zero-EXIT negative control; the manifest records the gate and gate.log holds the run's own summary line (53 passed, EXIT=0).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that the review readers read the committed review tree first and the staging store only for runs not yet promoted; reckon/crew/review.py:2003-2013 routes stored_record through committed_review_root/store/run/<run> before the staging root, and plan_review._candidate_paths (reckon/crew/plan_review.py:504-522) and list_plan_reviews (reckon/crew/plan_review.py:940-956) search the committed plan tree beside staging.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the gate command with tests/test_reviews_read_the_committed_store_first.py, the result on the tests line (53 passed, EXIT=0), test_logs naming gate.log, and negative_control_log naming negative_control.log whose last line is EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/review.py, reckon/crew/plan_review.py, reckon/crew/promotion.py, tests/test_reviews_read_the_committed_store_first.py and the evidence fragment; git show --stat over 389a80a4 lists exactly those five paths.

justifications.durability: the declared negative control (make stored_record read the staging store only) reddens exactly test_stored_record_reads_the_committed_tree_after_staging_is_deleted (1 failed, 52 passed, EXIT=1), and test_stored_record_reads_staging_for_an_unpromoted_run, test_a_review_in_both_trees_is_listed_once_as_the_committed_copy and the promotion spy would each redden on their regression; the committed-only discovery gap below is untested.
justifications.evidence: the done-when's gate is tests/test_reviews_read_the_committed_store_first.py with five sibling modules; the manifest records it and gate.log holds "53 passed in 71.31s" EXIT=0, and I reproduced the node's own module at 389a80a4 in this worktree (6 passed, EXIT=0).
justifications.fit: the added names describe mechanism (_select_stored_record, _build_store_indexes, _review_run_index, record_for_review_run, _plan_review_identity) with no version, plan, sprint or ticket identifier and no attribution; the tolerance/fallthrough idiom matches the surrounding store code.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/review.py:2003-2013 returns the committed run/<id>/<review>.json before consulting review_store_root (the staging store), and the node's own test test_stored_record_reads_the_committed_tree_after_staging_is_deleted confirms the committed copy answers with staging deleted.
justifications.reuse: the change extends owners rather than forking them — the shared selection rule is factored into _select_stored_record (reckon/crew/review.py:1899) for both trees, and promotion._staging_review_record_by_run (reckon/crew/promotion.py:7979) now calls the review store's own indexed lookup record_for_review_run instead of the directory walk it replaced, sharing one scan with _store_index.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat 389a80a4 lists only reckon/crew/review.py, reckon/crew/plan_review.py, reckon/crew/promotion.py, tests/test_reviews_read_the_committed_store_first.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the manifest's declared write paths.
